description: who (org.jwcarman.who) is a Spring Boot 4 / Spring Security 7 library for identity, sign-in and permissions: passwordless email links and codes, passkeys, Google, GitHub and OpenID Connect sign-in, API keys, JWTs, roles and @RequiresPermission, sessions, a Cloudflare Turnstile human check, and a TypeScript client.
rules: Import org.jwcarman.who:who-bom and add who modules without versions, rather than pinning each module's version.
Add who-spring-boot-starter plus one module per sign-in method; a module is on when its jar is on the classpath.
Supply secrets such as who.email-link.code-secret from environment variables with no default value in application.yml.
A SecurityFilterChain of your own that applies who's configurers must still call authorizeHttpRequests itself.
Check https://github.com/jwcarman/who/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md against the who version in use: entries under Unreleased are not in any release yet.
